run_distillation_training: run full off-policy distillation training from a teacher model to a smaller student model using command-line args
run_mixed_policy_distillation: run mixed on/off-policy distillation training with configurable lambda and beta weights
run_lora_distillation: run distillation training with LoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning on the student model
build_distillation_parser: build an argparse parser for the distillation training script with model, dataset, and training config
train_distillation_model: train a student model via knowledge distillation from a teacher model with optional eval and logging
